{{Recipe}}

'''Timatim fitfit''', also known as Ethiopian tomato salad, is a refreshing and vibrant dish made with ripe tomatoes, onions, and a tangy dressing. This salad is bursting with flavors and is a popular side dish in Ethiopian cuisine.

== Ingredients ==
* 4 ripe [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1 small [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeño]] pepper, seeded and finely chopped (optional, for spice)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:olive oil|olive oil]]
* 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed [[Cookbook:lemon juice|lemon juice]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:honey|honey]] or [[Cookbook:sugar|sugar]] (optional)
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* Fresh [[Cookbook:cilantro|cilantro]] or [[Cookbook:parsley|parsley]], chopped, for [[Cookbook:Garnish|garnish]]

== Equipment ==
* [[Cookbook:Mixing Bowl|Mixing bowl]]
* [[Cookbook:Cutting Board|Cutting board]]
* Chef's [[Cookbook:Knife|knife]]
* [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] or fork

== Procedure ==
# In a mixing bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, finely chopped onion, and jalapeño pepper (if using).
# In a separate small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, honey or sugar (if using), and a pinch of salt until well combined.
# Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture in the mixing bowl and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] gently to coat all the ingredients.
# Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt, if needed. You can also add more lemon juice or honey/sugar according to your preference.
# Cover the bowl and refrigerate the salad for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
# Before serving, garnish with freshly chopped cilantro or parsley.
# Serve the salad chilled as a refreshing side dish or accompaniment to Ethiopian main courses.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* You can customize the spice level of the salad by adjusting the amount of jalapeño pepper or adding [[Cookbook:Red pepper flakes|chili flakes]].
* The addition of honey or sugar in the dressing helps balance the acidity of the tomatoes. Adjust the sweetness according to your taste.
* Use ripe, juicy tomatoes for the best flavor and texture in the salad.
* For a milder flavor, you can remove the seeds from the tomatoes before dicing.
* Letting the salad chill in the refrigerator allows the flavors to develop and enhances the taste.
* To add more depth of flavor, you can include diced [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]] or [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]] to the salad.
* Some recipes include a sprinkle of ground [[Cookbook:Mitmita|mitmita]] spice for an extra kick of heat and flavor.

== Nutrition ==
* Tomatoes are rich in vitamins A and C, as well as antioxidants. They also provide dietary fiber and are low in calories.
